#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cctype>
using namespace std;

long long power_mod(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    int P, K;
    cin >> P >> K;

    if (K == 0) {
        cout << power_mod(P, P - 1, 1000000007) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (K == 1) {
        cout << power_mod(P, P, 1000000007) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<bool> visited(P, false);
    int cycle_length = 0;
    int p = 1;
    while (!visited[p]) {
        visited[p] = true;
        cycle_length++;
        p = (long long)K * p % P;
    }

    cout << power_mod(P, cycle_length, 1000000007) << "\n";

    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
